profile.headline: Software Engineer Associate
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
A team player committed to working within client and project specifications, as well as initiate and formulate ideas to deliver cost-effective timely results. Enthusiastic about engineering and creating practical web applications that has a lasting impact on the community at large.

Programming Language: Ruby, Javascript(AJAX, jQuery, Chrome Dev Tools), HTML, CSS
Frameworks: Rails, Sinatra, Bootstrap, Foundation
Testing: Test Driven Development, Agile Development
Database: SQL, PostgreSQL
Tools: Git, Heroku

positions.title: Software Engineer Associate
positions.description:
• Build and enhance the front-end of Kaplan Test Prep’s web applications.
• Work closely with Product/UX to turn mockups into simple and intuitive interfaces that work across all major desktop and mobile browsers.
• Write clean, semantic, efficient and reusable front-end code
• Optimize web application for maximum speed and scalability and analyze site/page speed and help provide performance solutions.
• Implement best SEO practices
• Collaborate with agile technical teams on functional projects

positions.title: Proprietor & Baker
positions.description:

• Manage pastry making, baking and purchasing supplies 
• Monitor quality of goods and services

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Build web applications utilizing Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, PHP/WordPress, HTML & CSS.
• Integrate e-commerce into web applications, using third-party API's.

positions.title: Research Assistant III
positions.description:
• Utilize CNExT Registry Software to maintain a Brain Tumor Registry of approximately 520 patient records. 
• Presented Research Findings at Caribbean Neurosciences Symposium in 2012 & 2013
• Abstracted, organized and validated data from patient charts
• Summarized, manipulated and statistically analyzed data for research papers
• Other Research Projects: Colon Cancer Registry (CCR), Trauma Registry

projects.title: MentorMe
projects.description: MentorMe is a scheduling app built and designed to conveniently pair students and mentors. Mentors can create appointments of availability and tag specific skill sets.  Students can select a mentor by tagged skills or time. Actionable, Specific and Kind feedback is encouraged once a session is completed. Technologies used: Ruby on Rails, Javascript, CSS, HTML5.

projects.title: Pi In The Sky
projects.description:
Web application designed to raise air quality awareness, provides real time local data from an MQ-135 sensor and an arduino, giving users access to global Air Quality Index(AQI) levels from an API and alerts them when their favorite cities AQI are out of range. As a standalone application using Ruby- Serialport, HTTParty gems, Google maps API & Twilio API. 

Log In email:  j@camp.com  pw: 123
